access.title: Permissions and quotas
access.description: Configure feature access, four-state domain permissions, and independent send/receive quotas. General quota 0 means unlimited; mail quota -1 means unlimited and 0 disables.
access.selectUserHint: Select a user to configure overrides
access.emperorLockedHint: This invariant is enforced in both the application and API; even the emperor cannot override it.
access.emperorQuotaEditableHint: Emperor feature access, general quotas, and domain permissions are locked. Send and receive quotas remain configurable.
access.overrideHint: Items without an override inherit the user's role. Permissions can be explicitly allowed or denied; quotas apply only when enabled.

domains.roleHelp: Controls which domains this role may use to create mailboxes and send or receive mail. Existing mailboxes remain visible.
domains.userHelp: Override the role's domain list for this user. An empty custom list denies every domain without hiding existing mailboxes.
domains.allowAll: Allow all current and future domains
domains.default: Default for unspecified and future domains

success.resetUser: The user now inherits all role defaults

sendQuota.title: Send quotas
sendQuota.help: The total and per-domain quotas apply together; either one can block a send. Windows are rolling, and one month is defined as 30 days.
sendQuota.userHelp: Unchecked values inherit the role. Once any send quota is overridden, this user is counted independently instead of consuming the shared role quota.

scope.role: Share one quota across the role

send.title: Send quotas
send.help: Total, domain, rolling mailbox, and lifetime mailbox limits apply together.

receive.title: Receive quotas
receive.help: Inbound delivery is rejected when any total, domain, rolling mailbox, or lifetime mailbox limit is exhausted.

mailQuota.userHelp: Unchecked values inherit the role. Any override is counted independently for this user.
mailQuota.domainMailbox: Override every mailbox in this domain

scope.role: Share aggregate quotas across the role

exact.title: Exact mailbox overrides
exact.help: Optional: set a different rolling and lifetime limit for one full mailbox address.
exact.invalidLocalPart: Use 1–64 letters, numbers, dots, underscores, plus signs, or hyphens

reset.title: Reset this quota usage?
reset.description: This permanently clears both rolling-window and lifetime counters for the selected direction and target. Policy limits are not changed.
reset.mailboxDescription: This permanently clears the selected direction's rolling and lifetime counters for {address}. Other mailboxes are unchanged.

blocks.title: Mailbox-name blocks
blocks.help: Block one local name globally or only for a selected user. Existing mailboxes are not deleted; new creation is denied until this entry is removed.
blocks.invalidLocalPart: Use 1–64 letters, numbers, dots, underscores, plus signs, or hyphens
blocks.deleteDescription: {address} can be created again by the affected users after removal.

success.fontDescription: Refresh the page to apply it to all server-rendered pages.
success.advancedSavedDescription: Refresh the page to apply it. Use safe appearance mode if the page becomes unusable.

font.title: Site-wide font
font.description: Enter a CSS font-family value. Only safe font names and fallback lists are accepted.

advanced.title: High-risk advanced appearance
advanced.subtitle: Inject CSS, Head HTML, end-of-Body HTML, and JavaScript directly
advanced.emperorOnly: Only an emperor account can edit advanced appearance.
advanced.warningTitle: Injected content runs with the current signed-in user's page privileges
advanced.warningDescription: Malicious HTML or JavaScript can read email, call APIs, or steal page data. Use only code you wrote and fully reviewed; never paste untrusted code.
advanced.enabledDescription: When disabled, saved content is retained but no advanced injection runs on the site.
advanced.customCssHelp: Appended to the end of page styles. You may use @font-face, @import, or override existing selectors.
advanced.customJsHelp: Do not include a <script> tag. Execution must also be enabled separately.
advanced.customJsPlaceholder:
// Runs in the browser
console.log("MoeMail custom appearance")
advanced.safeMode: If custom content makes the page unusable, append ?safe-appearance=1 to any page URL (or &safe-appearance=1 when a query already exists). That request skips all advanced injection so you can clear or fix it here.
advanced.limits: Each input is limited to 128 KiB and the total to 256 KiB. Content is stored in the current database and included in database backups.
advanced.clearDescription: This permanently deletes the saved CSS, HTML, and JavaScript and immediately disables advanced injection.
advanced.saveDescription: This content loads in every visitor's browser. Confirm that you wrote or fully reviewed it, then refresh the page after saving to verify it.
